def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find a full separator row or column, whose color occurs only in it.
    sep_row = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
                    if len(set(row)) == 1 and sum(x == row[0] for r in grid for x in r) == w), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        a = grid[:sep_row]
        b = grid[sep_row+1:]
        shared = set(x for r in a for x in r) & set(x for r in b for x in r)
        base = min(shared)
        return [[3 if x == y else base for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    sep_col = next(j for j in range(w)
                   if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1
                   and sum(row[j] == grid[0][j] for row in grid) == h)
    a = [[grid[i][j] for j in range(sep_col)] for i in range(h)]
    b = [[grid[i][j] for j in range(sep_col+1, w)] for i in range(h)]
    shared = set(x for r in a for x in r) & set(x for r in b for x in r)
    base = min(shared)
    return [[3 if x == y else base for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
